conclusions.claim: The supplied spectral table is a MID-channel-only, fraction-normalized estimator and cannot by itself support claims about absolute band energy, bass recovery, or stereo width.
conclusions.support: The packet states spectral fractions estimate mean mid-channel Hann-window FFT power normalized over 20-20,000 Hz (deepseek_packet.md:19-22). The context contract warns that fraction changes can reflect denominator or stereo changes and instructs measuring absolute and total L+R band power before claiming bass recovery (audio_context.md:54-57).

conclusions.claim: The three tagged WAVs are a sequential continuation lineage, not independent seeds or matched arms; cross-prime comparisons are confounded by online learning, target mix, and carried state.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:28-29 states the three latest WAVs form one sequential continuation lineage, not independent seeds or matched arms. audio_context.md:37-39 notes target mix and online learning confound comparisons between elapsed portions of a run. deepseek_packet.md:12-15 gives the step/update counts showing monotone progression.

conclusions.claim: The 60-second prime is selected by an internal score (field entropy, activity health, structured complexity, stagnation) with no listener rating or stereo/harshness ranking, so it can amplify a within-run outlier.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:51-53 and deepseek_packet.md:33-35. The scoring formula is visible in src/main.rs:8141-8145 and the sliding-window selection in src/main.rs:8459-8481.

conclusions.claim: The latest prime is drawn from a center-heavy interval of a non-uniform 600-second render; the full render is not uniformly centered.
conclusions.support: deepseek_packet.md:31-34 reports non-overlapping 60-second intervals with L/R correlation 0.740-0.992 and minutes 5-6 at 0.990-0.992 with side/mid about -23 dB.

conclusions.claim: The listener report of harshness and center bias is a single uncontrolled observation; no blinded listening has been performed, so no perceptual improvement or perceptual cause is established.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:58-60 states neither PI nor agents have performed controlled blinded listening yet and no perceptual improvement is established. deepseek_packet.md:7-8 instructs treating metrics as diagnostics and requiring listening for audible quality.

conclusions.claim: Offline waveform filtering tests signal processing only; it is not a proxy for latent-field diffusion, and latent field entropy cannot be recovered from a WAV.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:64-67. deepseek_packet.md:48-51 distinguishes signal-domain smoothing, latent-field diffusion, and a learned spectral/diffusion decoder.

conclusions.claim: The prompt file is written after rendering and prime extraction and cannot have caused the run; it may only influence a later external system outside this experiment.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:19-21. The write occurs at src/main.rs:8695-8697, after the mastering/prime block at src/main.rs:8448-8542.

conclusions.claim: The forward pass has no text prompt, target audio, prime, or external reference argument; target sampling occurs after forward.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:13-18. src/main.rs:7041-7054 calls model.forward before src/main.rs:7107 samples targets. docs/AUDIO_SCIENTIFIC_INSTRUMENTATION_PLAN.md:101 states the same ordering.

conclusions.claim: AdamW moments are persisted and resumed under strict compatibility conditions; the real reproducibility limitation is checkpoint-set transactionality, not absence of moment persistence.
The low-band loss term supervises only the first log band and is not the same as the 20-200 Hz measurement used in the survey table.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:40-43. METRICS.md:64-65 describes output_low_band_ratio as the first supervised 20 Hz log band. src/main.rs:7202-7210 shows first_band_energy_ratio usage.

conclusions.claim: Pan-center loss penalizes the bounded audible residual pan and does not directly reward correlation equal to one.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:44-47. src/stereo.rs:21-26 implements pan_center_loss as squared bounded pan. src/main.rs:7227 applies it to the bounded pan tensor.

conclusions.claim: Increasing side gain cannot synthesize missing side information; the side path derives from L-R before a delayed scaled side stage.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:44-47. src/main.rs:5569-5603 shows side derived from audio_l minus audio_r, scaled by width and delayed Haas history.

conclusions.claim: A sample peak below 0 dBFS does not exclude nonlinear saturation or perceptual harshness, because loss-visible tanh, later gain/saturation/DC blocking, and whole-file peak normalization are in the path.
conclusions.support: audio_context.md:48-50. src/main.rs:8059-8076 applies tanh and a stateful DC blocker; src/main.rs:8451 normalizes to -1 dBFS.

conclusions.claim: The trace's ultrasonic_ratio is a pre-master aliasing/foldback guardrail, not a harshness score.
The latest training trace shows the model narrower and more correlated than its targets, with global pan at its +0.10 limit and decoder width control at 0.120.
conclusions.note: Trace values are reported by the packet; the underlying trace file was not supplied for independent recomputation.
conclusions.support: deepseek_packet.md:37-40. The pan limit is defined in src/stereo.rs:3 and applied in src/stereo.rs:13-19.

conflicts.claim_a: The provisional request caveat suggested AdamW state may not be persisted.
conflicts.claim_b: Current Audio v9 persists AdamW moments and resumes them under strict compatibility conditions.
conflicts.discriminating_experiment: Inspect titan_optimizer_v9.safetensors and the run metadata optimizer_resumed and optimizer_migration fields after a controlled restart; confirm moments and cumulative update count match the pre-restart values.
conflicts.why_they_differ: The caveat predates or misreads the current implementation; the source-audit correction in docs/AUDIO_SCIENTIFIC_INSTRUMENTATION_PLAN.md:112-124 documents PersistentAdamW::save and restore conditions.

conflicts.claim_a: The latest continuation sounds harsh and centered (listener report).
conflicts.claim_b: The latest prime is drawn from a center-heavy interval, and the full render is not uniformly centered.
conflicts.discriminating_experiment: Blinded, level-matched listening across multiple non-overlapping intervals of the full render, including the widest and the most center-heavy windows, with hidden labels.
conflicts.why_they_differ: The listener may have heard the prime or a center-heavy portion; the report and the prime selection are not independent of each other.

limits: Fraction-only mid-channel spectra cannot support absolute-energy or stereo claims.
Internal metrics (sigma, phi, pi_proxy, empowerment, novelty_dmin, field_entropy, ultrasonic_ratio) are proxies or guardrails, not perceptual or causal measures (METRICS.md:45-95, 149-153).
Correlation and side/mid describe stereo geometry, not musical usefulness (audio_context.md:57).
Offline waveform filtering is not a proxy for latent-field diffusion (audio_context.md:64-67).
A zero-output identity branch proves bypass behavior only (audio_context.md:66-67).
Sample peak below 0 dBFS does not exclude saturation or harshness (audio_context.md:48-50).
Single-run, single-prime observations cannot establish a training-caused effect.
units: Band power in dBFS per channel and per mid/side, with explicit band edges and window parameters.
L/R Pearson correlation over a stated interval.
Side/mid as 10*log10(mean(side^2)/mean(mid^2)) with side=(L-R)/2 and mid=(L+R)/2, as defined in deepseek_packet.md:18-19.
Integrated loudness for level matching, with the applied gain recorded.

proposed_experiments.controls: Same window count, window length, and band edges for every file; report the estimator explicitly.
proposed_experiments.design: On the existing prime WAVs and on non-overlapping 60-second intervals of the full render, compute per-band absolute power in dBFS for L, R, mid, and side over fixed bands (for example 20-200 Hz, 200-2000 Hz, 2-6 kHz, 6-20 kHz). Report total L+R power and side/mid ratio per band. Use identical windowing and normalization across files.
proposed_experiments.expected_discriminator: If bass fraction fell because total energy rose rather than because low-band power fell, absolute low-band power will be flat or higher.
proposed_experiments.limits: Signal-domain measurement only; does not establish perceptual harshness.
proposed_experiments.name: Absolute and stereo-resolved band power re-measurement
proposed_experiments.purpose: Replace fraction-only mid-channel estimates with defensible units.

proposed_experiments.controls: Use the same score formula as src/main.rs:8141-8145 without modification.
proposed_experiments.design: Recompute the chunk-score sliding window over the full render and report the distribution of candidate 60-second windows by L/R correlation and side/mid. Compare the selected window against the median and against the widest window.
proposed_experiments.expected_discriminator: If the selected prime is an extreme outlier, its correlation and side/mid will sit far from the window distribution median.
proposed_experiments.limits: Does not change the renderer or checkpoint.
proposed_experiments.name: Prime-selection sensitivity audit
proposed_experiments.purpose: Quantify how much the reported center bias is an artifact of prime selection.

proposed_experiments.controls: Identical model, world, optimizer, RNG seed, and pre-forward state.
proposed_experiments.design: Clone identical pre-forward state and run forward with two different target chunks presented to the loader. Compare the emitted current-chunk audio byte-for-byte.
proposed_experiments.expected_discriminator: Identical current-chunk audio supports the no-reference-input claim; any difference would contradict it.
proposed_experiments.limits: Tests the current chunk only; later host feedback may still differ.
proposed_experiments.name: Frozen first-chunk invariance negative control
proposed_experiments.purpose: Confirm the forward pass has no reference input.

proposed_experiments.controls: No change to canonical checkpoints, corpus, or existing WAVs; outputs are copies with receipts.
proposed_experiments.design: On a copied WAV and a sidecar receipt, capture pre-side-scale, post-side-scale, pre-pan, and post-pan signals for the same interval. Report side/mid and correlation at each tap.
proposed_experiments.expected_discriminator: If side/mid is already low before the side stage, the collapse originates upstream; if it drops only after the side stage or pan, the stage is implicated.
proposed_experiments.limits: Requires renderer instrumentation that may not currently exist; treat as a proposal, not a completed measurement.
proposed_experiments.name: Sidecar renderer-tap capture
proposed_experiments.purpose: Localize center bias to a stage.

proposed_experiments.controls: Record level-matching gains; do not alter canonical files.
proposed_experiments.design: Select paired intervals of equal length from the untagged parent and the latest tagged continuation, match integrated loudness, and record the applied gain in a sidecar receipt. Report absolute band power and stereo geometry for each pair.
proposed_experiments.expected_discriminator: If differences persist after level matching, they are not explained by gain alone.
proposed_experiments.name: Level-matched paired-interval comparison

proposed_experiments.controls: Randomized order, hidden labels, level matching, documented exclusion rules.
proposed_experiments.design: Present level-matched, order-randomized, labeled-hidden excerpts to multiple listeners with a fixed rating instrument covering harshness and center bias. Report inter-rater agreement.
proposed_experiments.expected_discriminator: Consistent ratings above chance support the perceptual claim; chance-level ratings do not.
proposed_experiments.limits: Requires listeners and a protocol not currently available.
proposed_experiments.name: Blinded listening protocol
proposed_experiments.purpose: Establish or refute the perceptual claim.

proposed_experiments.controls: Use the recorded target identity, not a re-sampled corpus.
proposed_experiments.design: Compute the same stereo geometry and band-power statistics on the target episodes actually sampled during the run, using the recorded target_file and target_frame fields.
proposed_experiments.expected_discriminator: If targets are themselves center-heavy or bright, the model's geometry may be a faithful match rather than a defect.
proposed_experiments.limits: Depends on trace fields being complete.
proposed_experiments.name: Target-mix attribution audit
proposed_experiments.purpose: Determine whether center bias or brightness is inherited from targets.

answer_json.recommendation: Treat the current evidence as diagnostic only. Before any training fork, complete E1, E2, E3, and E5 on copies with sidecar receipts, keeping canonical checkpoints, corpus, and existing WAVs byte-for-byte intact. Do not equate signal-domain smoothing with quality, and do not treat waveform filtering as a latent-diffusion proxy. Any perceptual claim requires E6.
answer_json.speculation_label: Items marked as hypotheses or as proposals in proposed_experiments are untested. Trace-derived values in C15 are accepted as reported and were not independently recomputed.

uncertainties.impact: Bass-recovery and harshness claims cannot be evaluated from the table alone.
uncertainties.item: The supplied table reports only mid-channel fractions; absolute L+R band power, total energy, and per-band side energy are not provided.

uncertainties.impact: Audible quality and causal attribution to training remain unestablished.
uncertainties.item: No perceptual ratings, no blinded listening, and no independent training replicas are available.

uncertainties.impact: Cannot separate whether center bias originates in the learned renderer, the side stage, the pan head, or the target distribution.
uncertainties.item: Pre-side-scale renderer taps and frequency-specific loss gradients are missing.

uncertainties.impact: Cannot rule out that the target corpus itself is center-heavy or bright, which would confound any harshness attribution.
uncertainties.item: Detailed target mix attribution is missing.
The trace values in deepseek_packet.md:37-41 were not independently recomputed from the trace file in this review.

uncertainties.impact: Non-uniformity of the render is accepted as reported, not verified.
uncertainties.item: The 600-second render's interval statistics are reported but the underlying WAV was not supplied for recomputation.

uncertainties.impact: Corpus contamination cannot be confirmed or excluded from the supplied evidence.
uncertainties.item: Whether the two quarantine-provenance manifest entries entered gradients is unknown from manifest roles alone.

uncertainties.impact: Any effect of the prompt on an external system is outside this experiment and unmeasured.
